verdict.rationale: Sardine's own docs say its access-gated documentation includes SDKs and sample apps, and that a proprietary SDK collects device and behavioral signals. So official SDKs exist, but their scope and developer experience are not visible in the public evidence. Missing for 10: public SDK documentation or reference, supported languages and platforms, coverage of the server-side API (not just device signal collection), package distribution details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
